Anti-Dumping Duty on Electrical Steel May Increase Transformer Costs

The Global Trade Research Initiative (GTRI) has indicated that the imposition of an anti-dumping duty on electrical steel could lead to higher costs for transformers. This potential increase in transformer costs may subsequently impact the expansion of the electricity grid. The GTRI's analysis suggests a direct link between the duty and the financial implications for the power sector.
